summary: Tested reminder CRUD real-time refresh fix. Backend API calls (POST/PUT/DELETE) return 200 OK, but UI does NOT update immediately. The optimistic update via setReminders is not working - the popup shows the same count before and after operations. User must still refresh to see changes.

critical.issue: Optimistic updates not working - UI does not refresh immediately after ADD/DELETE/TOGGLE operations
critical.details: Backend API calls succeed (200 OK) but setReminders() does not trigger UI re-render in the popup

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/reminders returns 200 OK, setReminders called, but popup count stays the same
DELETE /api/reminders/{id} returns 200 OK, setReminders called, but popup count stays the same
PUT /api/reminders/{id}/toggle returns 200 OK, setReminders called, but toggle visual state doesn't change

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix optimistic update in ReminderCRUDPopup - setReminders is being called but UI doesn't re-render
Investigate why React portal (createPortal) might not be receiving updated props
Consider using useEffect to force re-render when reminders prop changes
Alternative: Use local state in popup that syncs with parent reminders prop
critical_code_review_comments: Line 262 (BeneficiaryPopups.tsx): setReminders((prev: any[]) => [...prev, newRem]) is called but popup doesn't re-render
Line 242: Toggle handler calls setReminders but visual state doesn't update
Line 246: Delete handler calls deleteReminder which uses setReminders but count doesn't decrease
Possible issue: React portal (createPortal) may have stale closure or not receiving updated props
seed_data_creation: Created multiple hydration reminders via API during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bug is NOT fixed. Backend API calls work (200 OK), but the UI does not update immediately. The setReminders optimistic update is being called but the ReminderCRUDPopup component is not re-rendering. This might be related to React portal (createPortal) not receiving updated props, or a stale closure issue in the onClick handlers.

frontend_ui_tests: Add reminder - FAIL (UI count stays same: 2 -> 2)

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The optimistic update via setReminders is being called, but the ReminderCRUDPopup component is not re-rendering with the updated reminders prop. This could be due to: (1) React portal (createPortal) not properly receiving updated props, (2) Stale closure in onClick handlers capturing old reminders array, (3) Missing dependency in useCallback/useMemo if used
reproduction_steps: 2. Navigate to dashboard and scroll to 'Mes rappels' section
3. Click on 'Hydratation' card to open ReminderCRUDPopup
6. Observe: Count does NOT increase immediately

mitigation_steps: Option 1: Use local state in ReminderCRUDPopup that syncs with reminders prop via useEffect
Option 2: Force re-render using key prop on the popup component
Option 3: Use React.memo with custom comparison function
Option 4: Move the reminders state management into the popup component itself
